function.name: get_coins_for_coinranking
function.description: This is the subfunction for tool "coinranking", you can use this tool.The description of this function is: "Get a list of coins. Coins are by default ordered by their rank, which - somewhat simplified - means that they are ordered on marketcap. The response not only returns a list of coins, but also statistics regarding the requested list, such as the volume in "

function.name: get_coin_exchanges_for_coinranking
function.description:
This is the subfunction for tool "coinranking", you can use this tool.The description of this function is: "Find exchanges where a specific coin can be traded.
This endpoint requires the **ultra** plan or higher."

uuid.description: UUID of the coin you want to request exchanges for

search.description: Value to search for within results, i.e. exchange names

orderby.description:
Index to order by. Default is 24h volume.

Default value: 24hVolume
Allowed values:
24hVolume price

orderdirection.description:
Order in ascending or descending order

Default value: desc
Allowed values:
desc asc

offset.description:
Offset. Used for pagination

Default value: 0

limit.description:
Limit. Used for pagination

Default value: 50
Size range: 0-100

referencecurrencyuuid.description:
UUID of reference currency, which rate is used to calculate the volume. Defaults to US Dollar

Default value: yhjMzLPhuIDl

function.name: get_coin_supply_for_coinranking
function.description: This is the subfunction for tool "coinranking", you can use this tool.The description of this function is: "Get the maximum, total, and circulating supply of a coin."

uuid.description: UUID of the coin you want to request the supply for

function.name: all_ticker_data_for_global_ethereum_price_index_gex
function.description: This is the subfunction for tool "global_ethereum_price_index_gex", you can use this tool.The description of this function is: "If no query parameters are sent, then returns ticker data for every supported symbol. If fiat(s) are sent as parameters, then only the ticker for those values is sent."

fiat.description: Comma separated list of ISO currency codes (ex. USD,EUR)

function.name: ticker_per_symbol_for_global_ethereum_price_index_gex
function.description: This is the subfunction for tool "global_ethereum_price_index_gex", you can use this tool.The description of this function is: "Returns ticker data for specified symbol"

symbol.description: ETH<fiat>, where <fiat> is valid ISO currency (ex. ETHUSD, ETHEUR)

function.name: ticker_changes_for_global_ethereum_price_index_gex
function.description: This is the subfunction for tool "global_ethereum_price_index_gex", you can use this tool.The description of this function is: "Returns ticker values and price changes for specified market and symbol."

symbol.description: Possible values: ETH<fiat> where <fiat> is valid ISO currency (ex. ETHUSD)

function.name: exchanges_for_tardis_dev
function.description: This is the subfunction for tool "tardis_dev", you can use this tool.The description of this function is: "Gets the exchanges details: available symbols, availability dates, available channels, CSV datasets info, incidents etc."
